Animated birthday cards that feel like a little party

A plain “happy birthday” text is gone in seconds. A WishCraft birthday card is something your friend opens, plays with and remembers: a gift box that wiggles until they tap it, your message written out like a letter, your photos as polaroids, and a cake whose candles they blow out before the whole screen bursts into confetti.

Make a birthday card · ₹30

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it. Now ₹30, usually ₹35.

What’s in your birthday card

  • A gift box that opens with a burst of confetti
  • Your message typed out on a handwritten letter, with soft typing sounds
  • Up to 5 photos as polaroids with your own captions
  • A cake with candles to blow out, and the “Happy Birthday” tune
  • A party-hat teddy (boy or girl) that runs around the cake
  • Background music from three built-in tunes: music box, happy or dreamy

Message ideas you can borrow

Another trip around the sun, and you still make everything brighter. I hope today brings loud laughter, too much cake and every person you love.
On your birthday I just want you to know how lucky I am to have you. You make ordinary days feel like celebrations.
Okay birthday star, it is officially your day. Eat the cake, make the wish, ignore the age. Love you lots!

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹30 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Can I send the birthday card to someone in another city or country?

Yes. You get a link, and it opens on any phone or computer in a web browser. There is nothing to install, and the person you send it to does not pay anything.

Can I add photos of the birthday person?

Yes, up to 5 photos, each with a short caption. They appear as polaroids that develop as the person scrolls.

How much does a birthday card cost?

Previewing is free. Sending the card costs ₹30 once (₹5 off the usual ₹35), paid by UPI, card, netbanking or wallet.
